component-registry.description: A central dictionary mapping string Types (e.g., "text-input", "row") to React Components and JSON Schema factories. Crucial for the "Toolbox" sidebar to know what can be dragged.

specs.behavior: Snap-to-grid during drag (using dnd-kit modifiers or custom sensor logic).

layout-engine.collision: Logic must prevent components from occupying the same "cell" or overlapping coordinates if absolute positioning is used (though current plan implies flow layout + reordering, strict grid placement might imply absolute or strict flex sizing). *Correction:* Given "Collision Detection" requirement, we are likely moving towards a more free-form or strict-grid hybrid, OR simply preventing invalid nesting/ordering.

responsive-preview.implementation: CSS-based width constraints on the main Canvas container. - Desktop: w-full - Tablet: max-w-[768px] - Mobile: max-w-[375px]
